title: GTA6 Trailer 2 Scene Gets Letterbox Removed in Latest PS5 Ad
description: A scene from GTA6 Trailer 2 has its letterbox removed in PlayStation's latest 'It Happens On PS5' video ad, sparking community discussion.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Trailer 2 Letterbox Removed in Latest PlayStation Ad

Ever since the release of the second official trailer for *GTA6*, the gaming community has been analyzing every single frame with microscopic precision. Recently, a discovery shared on the r/GTA6 Reddit community brought a fresh wave of excitement regarding a familiar scene.

According to community reports, PlayStation's latest video ad titled "It Happens On PS5" features a scene from the *GTA6* Trailer 2 that has had its letterbox removed. After a significant wait of 468 days, fans can finally see more of the frame—specifically, the tip of the framework on the left side of the scene is now much clearer. Additionally, eagle-eyed viewers noted that the contrast level of the scene has been decreased in this promotional version. However, one notable element from the original trailer, the floating light pole phenomenon, remains unaddressed and has not yet been fixed in this ad.

### Community Reactions and Observations

The long wait for *GTA6* has pushed the community to find joy in the smallest details. As noted by users discussing the ad online, the journey has been long, yet the shared anticipation has brought the player base closer together. While promotional ads frequently alter aspect ratios and visual grading for platform-specific formats, any official tweak related to *GTA6* naturally captures widespread attention.

### Editor's Take

PlayStation's latest ad offers a minor yet fascinating visual update for *GTA6* enthusiasts. While removing the letterbox and adjusting the contrast are likely standard video editing choices for marketing materials rather than direct in-game confirmation, it highlights just how closely the community is watching every official piece of media. Fans will undoubtedly continue dissecting every frame until Rockstar drops the next big update.
